critical.issue: Returns HTTP 422 (int_parsing on path param 'year') because the more general route DELETE /api/admin/officines-registry/garde-planning/{year}/{week} (registered first at line 360) shadows it (registered at line 369). The user's spec said 'period_start et period_end identiques [à monday/sunday]'. Currently a frontend consumer must use monday/sunday. Cosmetic — values are correct.

critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering bug in garde_planning.py is a classic FastAPI pitfall — when two routes share a prefix and the variable-position route comes first, the literal-segment one is shadowed.

rca of the issue: FastAPI matches routes in declaration order. Route DELETE /admin/officines-registry/garde-planning/{year}/{week} (line 360) was registered BEFORE the new DELETE /admin/officines-registry/garde-planning/year/{year} (line 369). When the request URL is /garde-planning/year/2026, FastAPI matches the first pattern with year='year' (string) and week='2026'. The string fails int parsing in Pydantic path validation → HTTP 422. Repro: curl -X DELETE -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin-token>' '$BASE/api/admin/officines-registry/garde-planning/year/2026' → 422 int_parsing. Mitigation: in routes/garde_planning.py, move the @api.delete('/admin/officines-registry/garde-planning/year/{year}') decorator + function ABOVE the @api.delete('/admin/officines-registry/garde-planning/{year}/{week}') one. After the swap the literal segment 'year' is matched first, restoring the intended behaviour.
